title: Request
description: Somebody asking somebody else for a time. A request, not a booking: it records what was asked, never that a slot is taken.

id.description: The record's own id in the system that holds it.

to.description: The wallet, handle, or id under localIds of whoever is being asked.

from.description: The wallet or local id of whoever is asking, when they have one. Absent for somebody with no account anywhere.

requester.description: Who is asking, as they gave it. Unverified, and read by a person.

contacts.description: How to reach whoever asked, so an answer can get back to them.

wanted.description: When they want, in their own words. Not a timestamp: a parsed date is a claim about a timezone and a working hour, and a person reading the words cannot misread them.

state.description: An answer is final. A second answer does not change the first.
